# Owned private two-formal carrier transfer

A real private static `<K,V> Map<K,V> make(Pair<K,? extends V>)` retains both
ordered method formals through the same complete carrier proof as public
transfers. A raw public wrapper calls the exact private declaration in its own
class. Both source and immutable carrier-JAR routes preserve every original
method/body/access flag and compile all generated Java. The original observer
checks both getter effects, partial snapshots, mutation, exact exceptions and
late result checks through four caller routes and three consumers.
Six same-Code Signature controls and eight independent wrong programs must fail.
No private sample material or third-party sources are included.
